sections.name: ProjectCount
sections.title: Yard project count line
sections.what: Shows a line such as the total number of projects in the Yard, followed by a note that coverage varies by sector. While loading it shows a placeholder bar, and if the data failed or is wrong it shows nothing, including when the user is signed out.
sections.why: Likely reason: the count is shared by two pages, and the note warns that the number is not equally complete for every sector.
sections.watch_out: On failure nothing appears at all, and no message says why, so a broken total looks like a missing feature.

summary: A one-line count of projects in the Yard, shown on the launcher and Yard pages, and hidden when the count cannot be trusted.
purpose: Gives a headline number of tracked projects with a note that coverage differs by sector.
why: The code comment says showing nothing is better than showing a misleading zero.
how: 1. Ask the totals hook for data. 2. While loading, show a grey placeholder bar. 3. If the request failed or the total is not a number, show nothing. 4. Otherwise format the totals and show them with the coverage note.
inputs: The totals data returned by the useProjectTotals hook, which fetches it.
outputs: A line of text, a placeholder bar, or nothing.
risks: Failures are silent. A missing count can look like the Yard is empty.
debug: If the line is missing, check whether the user is signed in, then the hook's request in the browser network tab. The hook and formatting function live elsewhere and were not shown.
